audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] calls Yone's E 'Spirit Rewind' and describes it as a blink out. Both are wrong: the ability is Soul Unbound (E, 22/19/16/13/10s), and it does not blink him away — his spirit leaves his body behind and is forced BACK to that body when the ability ends, repeating a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon: P Way of the Hunter, Q Mortal Steel, W Spirit Cleave, E Soul Unbound, R Fate Sealed. 'Spirit Rewind' does not exist. The escape direction matters: he returns to where his body was standing, so the counterplay is to stand on the body, not to chase the spirit.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound (E) sends his spirit out and snaps it back to his body — its rank-1 cooldown is 22 seconds and the snap-back location is known in advance.

audit.whatIsWrong: late says Fate Sealed (R) 'knocks up a line of enemies'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line and slashes so that all enemies hit are pulled TOWARDS him. The kit carries a dash flag and no knockup flag. A Shen told to expect a knockup will misjudge both his own positioning and whether knockup-dependent follow-ups from his team apply.
audit.corrected: He blinks behind the last champion in the line and drags everyone he hit back to him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound is named as the matchup-defining cooldown in a dozen fields but its actual duration is never given anywhere on the page.
audit.why: 22/19/16/13/10 seconds. The whole trading plan is 'engage when it is down', which is unusable without the number — and at rank 1 it is long enough to be a genuine window.
audit.corrected: 22 seconds at rank 1, falling to 10 at rank 5.

audit.why: Both layers agree (Skill/Shen/Shen/Skill/Skill/Shen/Shen). Yone's Mortal Steel is a 4-second cooldown with a knockup on the second stack and he has no hard escape besides the E snap-back, so Shen genuinely owns 2-3; the 9/10 carry rating correctly places his threat at two crit items.
Four spikes present: Lvl 2-3, Lvl 6, 1st item, Yone 2+ items. Ability naming inside them is clean — Spirit Cleave is correctly used for his W.

All four packet suspectNames ('Use Stand United', "Twilight Assault's", "Ki Barrier's", 'Shadow Dashing') are FALSE POSITIVES — every one is a correct Shen ability name in possessive or gerund form. The packet missed the two real errors ('Spirit Rewind', the Fate Sealed knockup).

edits.before: Use E (Spirit Rewind) to blink out before your taunt locks him into the W zone
edits.after: Use Soul Unbound (E) to snap back to his body before your taunt locks him down

edits.before: In teamfights Yone's R (Fate Sealed) is his most dangerous tool — it knocks up a line of enemies and resets his entire position. Use Stand United proactively so you arrive just before he ults, let him land Fate Sealed into your Spirit's Refuge zone, and his entire carry pattern is undone by the auto-block. In pure side-lane 1v1s at two items you can still trade favorably by baiting his E rewind with a faked E-cast, then Shadow Dashing the moment he snaps back — his rewind costs his escape and he has no second out. The matchup stays in your favor as long as you convert the global advantage into objectives rather than farming a stalemate.
edits.after: In teamfights Yone's R (Fate Sealed) is his most dangerous tool — he blinks behind the last champion in a line and drags everyone he hit back to him. Use Stand United proactively so you arrive just before he ults, let him land Fate Sealed into your Spirit's Refuge zone, and his entire carry pattern is undone by the auto-block. In pure side-lane 1v1s at two items you can still trade favorably by standing on his body while his spirit is out, then Shadow Dashing the moment Soul Unbound snaps him back — he has no second out. The matchup stays in your favor as long as you convert the global advantage into objectives rather than farming a stalemate.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Taunt in it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: He snaps back when it ends — 22s at rank 1. Taunt him inside it, or wait it out.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Taunt in it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1; he snaps back to his body when it ends, so wait on the body. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

notes: Two real defects, neither caught by the packet, while all four of its suspectNames were false positives: a fabricated ability name ('Spirit Rewind' for Soul Unbound) and a wrong ultimate mechanic (Fate Sealed described as a knockup when it is a pull toward Yone). Soul Unbound's real cooldown, 22s at rank 1, was missing from the whole page despite being the tracked cooldown.
